parts.t: [shouting] FUCK! [annoyed] These fuck ass nuns keep fucking meowing.
[suspicious] I think their ass is fucking possessed. [sarcastic] Fucking fantastic.
[storytelling] It all started when Mother Gertrude walked into Sunday service. Another day at church, right? [deadpan] Wrong.
[mocking] She decides: you know what? How about I ruin a fucking good morning.
[disbelief] So she meows, like a fucking...
[annoyed] She's only doing this 'cause she gets no attention at home. [angry] Stupid... stupid fucking bitch.
[relieved] Well, you'd think it'd be over after that, right?
[screaming] FUCKING WRONG! [panicked] The nun next to her starts meowing along, then the next, then the next. Now the whole church is meowing like it's possessed by a fucking humane society.
[exhausted] Now they do this shit every day. Never mind that it's six o'clock in the
[determined] So now I gotta call an army of soldiers to beat the shit out of these nuns, [shouting] 'cause they won't shut the FUCK up.
[furious] I'd rather rot in hell for pummeling the worshippers of God himself than deal with these nuns meowing at each other like holy hell.
[calm] Anyways... they stopped. [content] So that's nice.
